column1: # W60: self-conditioned (student-forcing) closed-loop evaluation on OmniGUI.
# WHAT THIS MEASURES, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT
#   Every multi-step number in the paper so far is teacher-forced: at step t the
#   prompt carries the GROUND-TRUTH actions of steps 0..t-1. That isolates the
#   per-step decision but cannot see error accumulation, which is the one risk a
#   write-once pruned KV history could plausibly introduce: an early mistake is
#   frozen into the cache, and the pruned cache may lack the evidence the dense
#   cache still has for correcting it.
#   GEOPACT_SELFCOND=1 closes the loop in ACTION space: the model's own parsed
#   predictions become the history and the KV commit turn. Screenshots stay
#   ground truth, because no GUI dataset ships the counterfactual frame that
#   would have followed a divergent action. So this is a self-conditioned replay
#   along a ground-truth visual trajectory, and frames go off-policy after the
#   first divergence.
#   That artifact is why the headline quantity is the PAIRED difference
#   dense - TRACE, not either absolute number: both arms inherit the identical
#   stale-frame confound, so it cancels in the difference.
# PROTOCOL, fixed across arms (vary only the selector and the budget):
#   MODEL_DIR=models/GUI-Owl-1.5-8B-Instruct   same backbone as the main tables
#   HIST_N=5                                    same history window as Table 2
#   LIMIT=-                                     FULL set, all 708 episodes.
#     Do NOT set LIMIT here: LIMIT truncates by STEP (islice), which cuts
#     episodes mid-trajectory and would silently drop the tail steps that carry
#     the accumulated error this experiment exists to measure.
#   GEOPACT_SELFCOND_STRICT=1 (default)         abort rather than warn if the
#     assistant tail stops carrying the stored prediction, which would turn the
#     run back into teacher forcing with no other visible symptom.
# ARMS. dense = baseline_full/00_baseline (no pruning). TRACE = abc_r10/v3_nap
# with the main-table selector settings, copied verbatim from
# logs/w57b_unified/omnigui so the self-conditioned and teacher-forced numbers
# are comparable arm-for-arm.
# BENCHMARK|TASK|TRACK|EXP_ARM|RATIO|HIST_N|OUT|LIMIT|EXTRA_ENV
# --- Tier ii: self-conditioned free run, dense vs TRACE at both budgets -------

omnigui|task_v2_qwen3_omni_novideo|baseline_full|00_baseline|-|5|logs/w60_selfcond/omnigui/sc_dense|-|MODEL_DIR=models/GUI-Owl-1.5-8B-Instruct,GEOPACT_SELFCOND=1,GEOPACT_SELFCOND_DUMP=logs/w60_selfcond/omnigui/sc_dense/selfcond.jsonl

omnigui|task_v2_qwen3_omni_novideo|abc_r10|v3_nap|0.10|5|logs/w60_selfcond/omnigui/sc_trace_c50_h10|-|MODEL_DIR=models/GUI-Owl-1.5-8B-Instruct,GEOPACT_RATIO_CURRENT=0.50,GEOPACT_BAM_ALPHA_CAL=1,GEOPACT_NAP_ANTICIPATE=0,GEOPACT_RECTIFY_PREFETCH=1,GEOPACT_CRS=1,GEOPACT_CRS_REP=stride,GEOPACT_CRS_NESTED=1,GEOPACT_CRS_NESTED_FRAC=0.05,GEOPACT_SELFCOND=1,GEOPACT_SELFCOND_DUMP=logs/w60_selfcond/omnigui/sc_trace_c50_h10/selfcond.jsonl

omnigui|task_v2_qwen3_omni_novideo|abc_r10|v3_nap|0.05|5|logs/w60_selfcond/omnigui/sc_trace_c25_h05|-|MODEL_DIR=models/GUI-Owl-1.5-8B-Instruct,GEOPACT_RATIO_CURRENT=0.25,GEOPACT_BAM_ALPHA_CAL=1,GEOPACT_NAP_ANTICIPATE=0,GEOPACT_RECTIFY_PREFETCH=1,GEOPACT_CRS=1,GEOPACT_CRS_REP=stride,GEOPACT_CRS_NESTED=1,GEOPACT_CRS_NESTED_FRAC=0.05,GEOPACT_BAM_MASS_ALPHA=2.0,GEOPACT_SELFCOND=1,GEOPACT_SELFCOND_DUMP=logs/w60_selfcond/omnigui/sc_trace_c25_h05/selfcond.jsonl
# Only three Tier-ii arms, not four: the dense arm does no pruning, so it has no
# budget and one dense run is the shared reference for both TRACE budgets.
# --- Tier iii: history contamination, {dense, TRACE} x {clean, injected} ------
# The clean half of the 2x2 is the Tier-ii runs above, so only the two injected
# arms are launched here. GEOPACT_SELFCOND_INJECT forces one wrong action into
# the history at a chosen step of every eligible episode; the metric is whether
# the NEXT step recovers. This is an intervention, not an observation, so it
# answers directly whether pruning removed the evidence needed to recover -- and
# it does not depend on the model happening to make mistakes on its own.

omnigui|task_v2_qwen3_omni_novideo|baseline_full|00_baseline|-|5|logs/w60_selfcond/omnigui/inj_dense|-|MODEL_DIR=models/GUI-Owl-1.5-8B-Instruct,GEOPACT_SELFCOND=1,GEOPACT_SELFCOND_INJECT=logs/w60_selfcond/inject.jsonl,GEOPACT_SELFCOND_DUMP=logs/w60_selfcond/omnigui/inj_dense/selfcond.jsonl
